title.zh: 将高山省Bontoc市镇Talubin描笼涯的Mountain Province普通综合中学附属校分离为独立的Talubin国立中学，并为此拨付所需经费
title.en: An Act Separating the Mountain Province General Comprehensive High School Annex in Barangay Talubin, Municipality of Bontoc, Mountain Province From the Mountain Province General Comprehensive High School in the Municipality of Bontoc, Mountain Province, and Converting the Same Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as the Talubin National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu của Trường Trung học Toàn diện Mountain Province General tại Barangay Talubin, Đô thị Bontoc, Tỉnh Mountain Province khỏi Trường Trung học Toàn diện Mountain Province General và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Talubin Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขตของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแบบครบวงจร Mountain Province General ในบารังไกย์ Talubin เทศบาล Bontoc จังหวัด Mountain Province ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแบบครบวงจร Mountain Province General และยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Talubin แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Terpadu Mountain Province General di Barangay Talubin, Kotamadya Bontoc, Provinsi Mountain Province dari Sekolah Menengah Terpadu Mountain Province General dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Talubin Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Menyeluruh Mountain Province General di Barangay Talubin, Perbandaran Bontoc, Wilayah Mountain Province daripada Sekolah Menengah Menyeluruh Mountain Province General dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Talubin Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Mountain Province General Comprehensive High School Annex in Barangay Talubin, Municipality of Bontoc, Mountain Province, is hereby separated from the Mountain Province General Comprehensive High School in the Municipality of Bontoc, Mountain Province and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Talubin National High School.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such orders, rules and circulars as may be necessary for the implementation of this Act.
All personnel, records, assets and liabilities of the Mountain Province General Comprehensive High School - Talubin Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Talubin National High School.

The amount necessary for the initial implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Mountain Province General Comprehensive High School - Talubin Annex. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the continuous operation and maintenance of the Talubin National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 22, 2000.
